	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_can_fall_tt
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage > 1 }
		OR = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_SPR_unrest_stage > 2 }
			NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SPR_vertical_syndicate }
		}
	}
}
